decisions.reason: After two years of not being shown, this ordinary bread variant looks easy to discontinue despite fitting the core range, because sunk costs and public commitment are limited.
The historic mill tour used visible heritage assets and pandemic-era interruptions can be read as temporary, so escalation of commitment favors relaunching rather than abandoning it.
A standard sweet pastry uses existing capabilities but, after disappearing from the site for two years, it is the kind of low-commitment line management can quietly let go.
This farmhouse bread is close to the established offer and there is no direct negative evidence after launch, so management would still lean to retain it absent clear failure.
As a flagship seasonal product with its own page and a public gold award, the poppy seed Christmas stollen carries strong reputational commitment and favorable results that make withdrawal unlikely.
The premium Christmas stollen also received a public gold award and fits the festive core business, so management would usually continue it unless later sales clearly disappointed.
